hook_text: One park, every Term 3 topic. How many can you spot before the slide?
clip_script: New park in Mbombela! Walking path: 1,25 km, that is 1 250 m. Sandpit: 6 by 4. Around it, 20 m. Inside it, 24 square metres! Stop sign: regular octagon, 8 lines of symmetry. Slide: acute angle. Hexagon paving: no gaps. Climbing frame: a square-based pyramid, 5 faces, 5 vertices, 8 edges. And the map? Five times the plan. Every topic, one park!
visual_style: A bright park seen from a drone, with labels and measurements popping up on each feature as the camera glides past.
mood: Cheerful and proud, like opening day.
pacing: A smooth fly-through with quick pauses at each feature, ending on the map at the gate.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find three Term 3 shapes on your way home.
